content:
jen: CI microbench failed on PR #12901 — autotuner tweak seems to spike kv-batch tail p99 +28%.
ci-bot: CI benchmark kv-micro: FAILED — tail_latency p99 12.3ms -> 15.8ms (+28.5%). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/perm/1234
rafael: Oof. Which commit touched kernel_autoselect.py? I recall a sample-weight change.
jen: This PR splits affinity into 'seq_bucket' branches; suspect sampler weight. Patch touched runtime/sampler/affinity.py and kernel_autoselect heuristics.
priya: Can you paste microbench output + /proc/cpu + warmup traces?
jen: ```
Before: tail_p99: 12.3ms
After:  tail_p99: 15.8ms
Hitrate: before 86.2% -> after 72.1%
Warmup cycles: before 120 -> after 32
Command: ./bench/kvcache_micro --repeats=3 --batch=8
```
sam: Ran perf on CI image: KV hitrate down ~14% for seqlen dist skewed to 256. Prefetch window reduced in new heuristic.
yvonne: If hitrate drops, runtime may select fast_no_prefetch kernel. Check kernel_choice logs (runtime debug level).
jen: ```
[runtime] selected_kernel=batch_prefetch_v2 reason=cost_model_score 0.12
[runtime] selected_kernel=fast_no_prefetch reason=cost_model_score -0.82
# observed path: previously picked batch_prefetch_v2, now fast_no_prefetch for same inputs
```
casey: Bisect suggestion: revert sampler weight commit and re-run microbench. If perf recovers that's our culprit.
jen: Starting bisect now: git checkout a1b2c3.. will run bench CI repro locally and on presubmit image.
perf-infra-bot: Enqueued reproducer on ci-presubmit-3 (job 4678). ETA ~12m. https://ci.redwood/job/4678
rafael: If bisect confirms, open a minimal revert PR. Don't rollback unrelated changes — keep it surgical.
jen: Bisect step 1: revert commit a1b2c3 -> tail_p99 15.8ms -> 12.5ms.
priya: Nice. Repeat 5 runs for stats.
jen: 5 runs: after PR [15.8,16.0,15.6,15.9,15.7] baseline [12.3,12.5,12.4,12.6,12.4] revert [12.5,12.6,12.4,12.7,12.5]
sam: Confirmed. Creating minimal revert PR now and marking it a rollout blocker. :rotating_light:
jen: @rafael can you add a short postmortem note + add perf unit to PR gating to prevent regressions?
rafael: Will add note and a perf-unit check for kvcache microbench in presubmit. Also adding a tiny golden for warmup cycles.
jen: Thanks everyone. Rolling back the change; will follow up with a deeper root cause investigation (cost model tuning vs warmup interaction and kernel selection thresholds).
